title: Hold a restricted ambulance service licence
what: Provide non-emergency ambulance services only under a restricted ambulance service licence, unless SA Ambulance Service carries them out or directs them, or an exemption applies.

sources.title: Health Care Act 2008 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not provide non‑emergency ambulance services unless— (a) the services are carried out— (i) by SAAS; or (ii) by a person acting under the direction or request of SAAS; or (b) the person holds a licence under this section (a restricted ambulance service licence)

administration.who: Minister administering the Health Care Act 2008 (SA)
